basics.name: Wilder H. Lizama Garcia
basics.occupation: Senior Frontend Engineer | React • React Native • TypeScript • Next.js
basics.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer building scalable web and mobile apps with React, React Native and TypeScript.
basics.tagline: Frontend architecture, reusable UI systems and legacy modernization, working with remote international teams across fintech, ERP, healthcare and nonprofit platforms.
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 11+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications with React.js, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript and Next.js, including 6+ years working remotely with distributed international teams. Experienced across fintech, insurance and healthcare, ERP systems and nonprofit platforms. Strong expertise in frontend architecture, reusable UI systems (Storybook, Tamagui, Atomic Design), API integrations (REST, GraphQL), PWAs and cross-platform mobile development with React Native and Expo. Proven experience modernizing legacy systems, migrating desktop software to the web and JavaScript applications to TypeScript, backed by full-stack experience with Node.js, SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Comfortable in agile environments, focused on performance, scalability, maintainability and user experience.

work.name: Rimac Seguros y Reaseguros
work.summary: Expo apps for healthcare and insurance, a Tamagui component library built on Atomic Design, and the move from Expo to React Native CLI.
highlights: Developed, published, and maintained Expo-based mobile applications for healthcare and insurance products, ensuring high performance, stability, and reliable release cycles.
Managed App Store and Google Play releases with EAS Build and EAS Submit, and shipped over-the-air updates with EAS Update.
Integrated Firebase for push notifications (FCM), crash reporting (Crashlytics), authentication and Firestore.
Wrote unit, component and end-to-end tests with Jest, React Testing Library and Playwright, and worked with CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
Designed and developed a reusable mobile component library using Tamagui following the Atomic Design methodology, improving UI consistency, scalability, and code reuse across multiple projects.

Led the migration of mobile applications from Expo to React Native CLI, adapting native configurations, dependencies, and build processes to support advanced native capabilities and long-term maintainability.
Developed a healthcare mini app and integrated it into the Rimac Seguros Super App, delivering a seamless user experience within the company's mobile ecosystem.
Managed and maintained cloud infrastructure and services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), supporting application deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability.
Leveraged AI-powered development tools to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate feature delivery, improve code quality, and enhance overall team productivity.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an Agile (Scrum) environment, participating in sprint planning, code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous delivery practices.

work.name: DevBase (acquired by Fintech Automation)
work.summary: JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration of a grantmaking platform, a financial PWA, and Storybook UI libraries.
highlights: Migrated a nonprofit grantmaking platform from JavaScript to TypeScript, improving maintainability and type safety across the frontend architecture.
Developed and maintained React Native features for a production mobile application used by HVAC field technicians.
Published React Native app releases to the App Store and Google Play.
Wrote unit and component tests with Jest and React Testing Library, and worked with CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
Maintained and enhanced a Progressive Web Application (PWA) for a financial platform handling cash and bank account operations through API integrations.
Built reusable UI component libraries using Storybook and Atomic Design, reducing UI inconsistencies and accelerating frontend development.
Integrated REST APIs for transaction processing and backend communication.
Collaborated with distributed engineering teams in remote agile environments.

work.name: GNT Servicios Generales S.A
work.summary: Desktop software migrated to React and Kendo UI web apps; ERP systems and enterprise intranets.
highlights: Led the migration of desktop software into modern web applications using React.js and Kendo UI.
Developed and maintained ERP systems and enterprise intranet platforms with Material UI, Bootstrap and GraphQL, focused on operational efficiency and business workflows.
Designed and maintained T-SQL database structures and optimized SQL Server operations.
Built Gmail API integrations to automate electronic document registration.
Built background Java services for asynchronous server-side execution.
Provided server support for IIS and Ubuntu Linux environments.
Worked remotely with the team from 2020 onwards.
